$comment: Starting point for a new brand. Copy this file to brands/<slug>/brand.json (slug = a short, URL-safe id like 'parks'), then also copy this template's sibling assets/ layout: brands/<slug>/assets/<logo files>, and brands/<slug>/source-documents/ only if this brand is extracted from an existing print style guide (omit entirely otherwise, and drop 'sourceFile' below). Run `node scripts/validate-brand.js` then `node scripts/build-all.js` once filled in. See brands/county-of-marin/brand.json for a fully filled-out, PDF-extracted example; brands/fixitmarin/brand.json for one extracted from a live webpage instead (sourceUrl, no identity/graphicMark, empty typography.families, plus the illustrations/printMaterials/socialMedia blocks below); and schemas/brand.schema.json for what's actually required versus optional. Every block below except brand/purpose/logos/colors/typography/fileFormats is optional — delete what this brand doesn't have rather than leaving it empty.

brand.name: Replace with the brand's real name, e.g. "Marin County Parks"
brand.website: Optional — https://… link shown as Website: under the description
brand.lastUpdated: Optional free-text date, e.g. September 30, 2026 — omit to hide the 'Updated ...' line
brand.sourceUrl: Optional — use instead of sourceFile when this brand's canonical guide is a live webpage, not an archived PDF. See brands/fixitmarin/brand.json.

purpose.summary: One or two sentences: who this guide is for and what it keeps consistent.
goals: Why consistency matters for this brand — one goal per line.

symbol.name: Optional — name of the primary graphic mark, if it has a documented story worth telling
symbol.description: What the symbol depicts and why.
meaning: What it represents — one idea per line. Delete this whole 'identity' block if there's no story to tell.

generalRules: Rules every use of this brand's logos must follow — e.g. never stretch, never recolor.

variants.name: Primary Logo
variants.usage: When to use this one over the others.

graphicMark.name: Optional — a stripped-down graphic-only mark for use as a design element, if this brand has one
graphicMark.colorRule: Any color restriction on this specific use.

guidance.primaryPalette: The brand's core colors and how they're used.
guidance.secondaryPalette: Supporting colors, if any, and when to reach for them.
guidance.continuity: Why the palette matters across different materials/departments.

guidance: Typeface rules — which face for what purpose.

digitalImplementation.note: How this brand is actually implemented on MarinOS digital products, if it diverges from a print guide — see marin-digital-standards/brand/typography.md for the pattern this follows.
digitalImplementation.heading: e.g. Jost (marin-ui shared bundle)

fileFormats.masterArtworkRule: The one rule about not altering supplied artwork.

publicationNotes: Anything a reader should know about this guide's status, gaps, or what's still pending approval.

qrCodeLogos.guidance: Logos made for the center of a QR code. A square PNG works best.

illustrations.$comment: Optional — delete this whole block if this brand has no supporting scene/concept graphics beyond the logo itself. See brands/fixitmarin/brand.json.
illustrations.guidance: When/how these illustrations should be used.

items.name: Example Illustration
items.usage: What this illustration shows and when to use it.

printMaterials.$comment: Optional — delete if this brand has no posters/flyers distributed as a linked page rather than a direct downloadable image.
printMaterials.guidance: What's available and how it's distributed.

socialMedia.$comment: Optional — delete if this brand has no ready-to-post social assets with suggested captions.
socialMedia.guidance: How these assets should be used on County/department/partner channels.

lines: One caption line per array entry.
